messages:
Maria (Marketing): heads-up — EU-west partial degradation just hit prod (affects inference routing for some customers). need marketing support for customer-facing copy + timing. can ops/SRE share estimated blast radius and suggested cadence?
Sam (SRE): working on it. currently impact on 3 node pools behind the gateway. ~20% of requests in eu-west see increased latencies/errors. we’ve set circuit to fallback to eu-central for new connections. investigating cause, no rollback planned yet.
Maria (Marketing): ok — we should prepare: 1) status page blurb, 2) targeted email to impacted orgs, 3) short social/status note if incident >30m. want to avoid premature public tweet.
Aj (Ops): for timing: if SRE confirms mitigation (fallback) is stable we can wait 30m then post status page entry and email impacted customers. if latencies persist beyond 1hr escalate to broader comms.
Eve (Customer Success): please include a short CS play script for CSMs to DM customers. also need list of impacted accounts (team, cluster id) — will use for direct outreach.
Sam (SRE): quick numbers: ~18 orgs showing errors (dev+some staging), 5 paying customers with production traffic impacted (IDs: redwood-orp1, acme-inc, fluxly). attaching rough cutoff criteria.
Maria (Marketing): thanks. draft copies below — please react with :thumbsup: to approve or reply with edits. posting these to status page and email list if approved in 30m.
Maria (Marketing): STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
```
Investigating — Partial degradation in eu-west
We are investigating elevated latencies and intermittent errors affecting a subset of requests routed to eu-west. We have implemented automatic fallback routing to eu-central for new requests to reduce impact. Engineers are actively diagnosing the root cause.
Impacted services: Inference API (text generation), Routing layer.
Updated at: 2026-03-21 14:02 UTC
```
Maria (Marketing): EMAIL SUBJECT OPTIONS:
- "Redwood: Temporary service degradation in eu-west — mitigations in place"
- "Service notice: eu-west partial degradation"
Maria (Marketing): EMAIL BODY (short):
Hi {first_name},
We’re reaching out because you may have experienced increased latencies or intermittent errors for requests routed to our eu-west region today. We’ve implemented automatic fallback routing to eu-central which should reduce impact for new requests. Our engineers are actively investigating and we’ll send another update in 30 minutes or sooner if the situation changes.
If you believe your production traffic is impacted, reply and we’ll prioritize outreach.
Thanks,
Redwood Operations
Sam (SRE): small tweak — mention that requests in-flight may still see errors; fallback applies to new connections only. add line: "in-flight requests may still fail; reconnects should route to eu-central."
Maria (Marketing): updated.
Eve (Customer Success): CS DM script: "Hi — we’re aware of a partial degradation in eu-west affecting some requests. We’ve enabled fallback to eu-central. If you see persistent production errors, please reply and we’ll prioritize." keep it short so CSMs can paste.
Aj (Ops): compliance/legal checks: any wording with SLA/credits we should avoid promising? we should add: "We are investigating and will update on root cause and any follow-up actions." keeps it neutral.
Maria (Marketing): added neutral line to email and status page.
Sam (SRE): posting status update now. will update thread with new timestamps.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21T14:03Z created — incident id INC-20260321-42 (severity: sev-2).
Maria (Marketing): ok — plan: if no major regression in 30m we post the email to impacted customers list and update status page public entry. if things worsen we go to a broader public notice + hold a short webinar for enterprise customers (if >10 paying customers impacted) — keep marketing on standby.
Eve (Customer Success): will queue CSM outreach for the 5 impacted paying customers now and hold DM templates ready.
Aj (Ops): ops to confirm mitigation window by 14:30 UTC (thread will be the approval channel). please use :thumbsup: here to sign off for send.
Maria (Marketing): approved copy attached. if no objections by 14:30 we send initial email + status page entry.
Sam (SRE): :thumbsup: will post follow-up at 14:18 with updated metrics.
Maria (Marketing): thanks everyone — keeping social on pause until we confirm customer emails went out. @Eve please ping when DMs are sent.
Eve (Customer Success): will ping once outreach done.
Maria (Marketing): final note — marketing will prepare a short post-incident brief (1 pager with timeline + impact + remediation) for PR and sales ops if this becomes customer-facing beyond the email.
Sam (SRE): noted. updating this thread with timeline events as they happen.
Maria (Marketing): thanks — this is the canonical comms thread for the incident from marketing side.
